subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve already-loaded plugins across scoped harness activation

question: Should scoped harness activation preserve unrelated registrations through a registry merge or request-scoped handle, rather than reloading every currently active plugin?
rationale: Repository lifecycle policy and existing redundant-registration evidence make broad re-execution unsafe to accept implicitly, while complete disablement semantics affect which plugin capabilities may remain live.

options.title: Preserve registrations at the registry seam
options.body: Merge or scope only the newly required harness registrations, retain unaffected live surfaces, and remove every surface rejected by canonical activation policy.

options.title: Approve broad plugin re-registration
options.body: Accept re-executing all live plugins only after explicit lifecycle, disablement, startup-cost, and upgrade proof documents that contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve registrations at the registry seam
recommendation.body: Merge or scope only the newly required harness registrations, retain unaffected live surfaces, and remove every surface rejected by canonical activation policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the active registry and runtime lifecycle makes this person the best available owner for the preservation-seam decision.
